title: Levi bar Darga
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was very wealthy. Hyman, citing [Gittin 45a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.45a.15-16), relates that he ransomed his daughter, who had been taken captive, for three thousand gold dinars. Abaye said concerning this, “Who can tell us that he acted with the sages' consent?”[^1][^2]

notes.text: Abaye asks whether the sages approved; he does not state categorically that they disapproved.

Hyman gives three thousand gold dinars. The linked Gemara reads thirteen thousand gold dinars (בתליסר אלפי דינרי זהב). [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2360&lang=en) also gives thirteen thousand, and says he does not know whether Levi was a sage.
